purpose: Diagnose and correct the V14 EDM noise-scale mismatch without post-hoc spectral rescaling, target-derived inference features, or independent-data reuse.

measurements: fixed-sigma denoising MSE relative to the zero estimator
fixed-sigma denoising MSE relative to the noisy input
fixed-sigma Fourier-band error over target residual power
four-band field-statistic trend over the three frozen V14 candidates
generated over truth peak and void count trend
e0_diagnostic.decision: E0 cannot promote a model or alter a gate. E2 runs next regardless of E0 values.

e2_noise_distribution.single_change_from_v14: replace fixed edm_p_mean=-0.8 by log(0.6*sigma_data), retaining edm_p_std=1.2
e2_noise_distribution.selection: smallest candidate passing all unchanged V6 field checks in all three development domains

e3_tail_weight.run_only_if: E2 has no three-domain passing candidate
e3_tail_weight.single_change_from_e2: reduce inverse density-frequency tail exponent from 0.5 to 0.25
e3_tail_weight.selection: smallest candidate passing all unchanged V6 field checks in all three development domains

fixed_decision_order: run E0 without selecting or changing any candidate
train and gate E2 exactly as declared
if E2 passes, stop development and create a new committed independent seal
if E2 fails, train and gate E3 exactly as declared
if E3 passes, stop development and create a new committed independent seal
if E3 fails, stop without opening Astrid and escalate to a separately predeclared representation redesign
